issues.title: Newsletter Edition#1
issues.preview:
✨ Here's what's inside our first edition:

🎉 Event Recap: Relive the highlights of our recent Speed Friending event!

🎃 Upcoming Events: Get ready for our Halloween Party on 29 October, featuring a pub crawl and exciting perks!

📊 Curiosity Corner: Discover why correlation doesn't always mean causation, and learn a handy Python trick using value_counts()!
